title: Algebraic closedness of the fraction field of an integral closure
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $K$ an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and $A\to K$ any ring map. Let $B$ be the integral closure of the image of $A$ in $K$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Then $\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ is algebraically closed.
